title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Courtesy Training Questions: Lateness Adjustment
content:
**What is the lateness adjustment on a late fee courtesy credit?** On a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account, the lateness adjustment is added to the courtesy share, the share of the late fee being reversed that the courtesy credit returns. It is minus 0.3 when the late fees assessed on the account with a transaction date fewer than 12 full calendar months before today, other than the fee being reversed and less the late fee reversals with the reversal reason assessed in error dated fewer than 12 full calendar months before today, number two or more; minus 0.15 when they number exactly one; and zero when they number none. The courtesy share is never below zero and never above 1.0.

**Which fee is the fee being reversed?** The most recent late fee on the account; it is left out of the count.

**Do courtesy reversals lower the count?** No. Only late fee reversals with the reason assessed in error are deducted.

## Count and adjustment

| Other late fees in the span, net of assessed-in-error reversals | Lateness adjustment |
|---|---|
| two or more | minus 0.3 |
| exactly one | minus 0.15 |
| none | zero |

## Worked cases (hypothetical accounts)

| Late fees in the span, including the fee being reversed | Assessed-in-error reversals in the span | Other late fees, net | Adjustment |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 | 0 | zero |
| 2 | 0 | 1 | minus 0.15 |
| 3 | 0 | 2 | minus 0.3 |
| 3 | 1 | 1 | minus 0.15 |
